title: Delivery log row (schema 1)
description: One row per delivery at pk EVENT#<eventId>, sk DELIVERY#<deliveryId>; GSI byRecipient on (recipientKey, queuedAt). Addresses are never stored: recipientKey is a pseudonym and destinationMask hides the address. A status never moves backward; see delivery_log.next_status.

recipientKey.description: HMAC of the address, or a Person or site-subject reference. Never an address.

expiresAt.description: Epoch seconds; DynamoDB TTL. Set from one retention setting (90 days).

cost.description: Decimal string: the running total charged for this delivery by a channel that bills per request. Only ever grows.

costCurrency.description: The currency of cost, for example USD. One currency per delivery.

costNote.description: Where the prices applied came from, as the host stated them, for example the price list and its date.

withdrawnBy.description: Who withdrew the post, as the host named them.
